change: Increase video duration to capture mid-form engagement sweet spot
rationale: Videos with 50-70s potential (based on 55-71% retention of 35s = 19-25s actual watch time) can extend that engagement window. Mass Spectrometer (55% retention) and Electric Arc Furnace (71% retention) show audiences stay engaged beyond current cutoff.
expected_impact: 15-25% increase in total watch time minutes per video, improved algorithmic promotion due to longer session duration

change: Reduce media item count to increase dwell time per visual concept
rationale: High retention videos likely have clearer visual narratives. At 35s with 12-20 items, each visual gets 1.75-2.9s. Reducing to 10 items gives 3.5s per visual, allowing better comprehension of complex topics like mass spectrometry and fiber optics.
expected_impact: 8-12% improvement in average retention rate by reducing cognitive overload, particularly for technical topics
